sections.title: Commercial progress and 2027 direction
sections.body: 94 clients have contracted for Rewards as of October 21, per Britton. This is a contracted-client count, not a live-client count. Trinity issued 104 million points in September, generating $1.04 million in points sales. New pricing is available in Salesforce. Inside Sales received a refresher on October 19. Chase approved the Landmark deal, with contracting expected in October per Alex, and additional student operators are in the pipeline. Continued Rewards sales in 2027 confirmed. Open Rewards pipeline totals $801,842.67 in unweighted ACV across 50 opportunities with expected closes in October-December 2026. This includes expansion opportunities and is not a count of new clients or booked revenue.

sections.title: Trinity rollout readiness
sections.body: October 28 training and November 2 rollout are delayed. November 18 is tentative internal training, dependent on the required permissions and approval functionality; no replacement launch date is confirmed. Trinity expects ongoing service-recovery incentives rather than another September-sized issuance event. Trinity confirmed that the proposed approval workflow meets its regional needs; delivery and successful client testing remain outstanding.
